notes: Physical I/O confirmed from Bolin's own datasheet (rear-panel photo + spec tables) and the official B2-210/B2-220 User Guide (rear-panel diagram, page 11), which agree exactly. The B2-220 has NO 3.5mm audio jack on the body (that is exclusive to the B2-210) — Bolin's manual explicitly states "The B2-220 does not have a 3.5mm audio input connection. Please use the USB port to 3.5mm audio jack [adapter, not included] to input audio," so no analog audio port is listed here. IR remote receiver and a bottom-panel 8-pin x2 dip-switch block also exist but are not user-facing signal/power connectors in the requested sense, so they are omitted. The rear panel shows both a USB-A port and a USB-C port; the datasheet's interface table names only "USB Port: USB2.0, Type C" as the functional streaming/UVC-UAC interface, so the USB-A port's exact role is inferred (likely accessory/service use) — flagged as the one medium-confidence item in an otherwise high-confidence, manufacturer-sourced spec. No rack mounting (desktop/ceiling/wall-mount PTZ camera, so rackUnits omitted). SDI grade (3G-SDI) and HDMI grade (1.4) and Ethernet grade (1000BASE-T = 1G) are explicitly stated in the datasheet. USB is explicitly "USB2.0, Type C" per spec table.
